title: Lawyer's office and car robbed

tellings.quote: No, but my lawyer had her office and her car robbed.

plain: Gary McKinnon is a British computer hacker who says he broke into NASA systems in the early 2000s and found signs of a secret space programme. Talking to podcast host Jesse Michels, he says that during those years his lawyer's office and her car were both robbed. He tells it as a hint that someone may have been after his case.
